snippet.title: Hello Sunshine Deep Dive - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Red Thread Games took us on a journey into the mysterious world of Hello Sunshine during this year's Spring Showcase, revealing more about this emotional adventure game where you survive in the shadow of a big, friendly robot. Hello Sunshine is coming soon to PC, with a playtest arriving in the near future.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3245140/Hello_Sunshine/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
